name: googleupdate.exe
description: Google's background updater for Chrome and other Google apps. Safe to lower priority; it runs silently.

name: msedgeupdate.exe
description: Microsoft Edge's background updater. Runs periodically and is safe to deprioritise.

name: onedrive.exe
description: Microsoft OneDrive sync client. Uses disk and network when syncing; can be slowed with Efficiency Mode.

name: searchindexer.exe
description: Windows Search indexer. CPU- and disk-intensive during initial indexing; safe to suspend temporarily.

name: antimalware service executable
description: Windows Defender real-time protection (MsMpEng). Never touch this.

name: msmpeng.exe
description: Windows Defender antimalware engine. Protected — do not act on it.

name: chrome.exe
description: Google Chrome browser. Each tab and extension is a separate process; the main process holds all of them.

name: discord.exe
description: Discord desktop client. Runs multiple helper processes; the main window process is the one to act on.

name: steam.exe
description: Steam game client. Background process handles friends, downloads, and updates.

name: updater.exe
description: Generic software updater from an unknown vendor.
